summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload unrelated to package purpose
details: @servicetitan/ld-type-generator@0.2.6 declares its purpose as generating TypeScript types for LaunchDarkly flags, but its `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated script (`_0x...` identifiers, shuffled string maps) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated blob (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotated string-array decoder over an array of hex/int/short-string fragments, no readable URLs or SDK identifiers) whose content is deliberately opaque to Node-based inspection. The Bun runtime is used only to execute this opaque sibling payload; nothing in the declared type-generation CLI requires an alternate JavaScript runtime. Alternate-runtime execution of an obfuscated payload from a `preinstall` hook fires automatically on `npm install`, so the payload runs in every installer's environment without user action, and its true behavior (including any network destinations, credential access, or persistence) is hidden from static inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
